description: A free teaching and reference generator that builds classic colour vision illusions right on the timeline, with a burned in commentary overlay that explains what each one is doing. A Reveal slider wipes the surround to neutral grey so you can prove the trick to yourself, and Simulate Appearance draws the percept your eye reports instead of the numbers. Also carries passthru modes that run on your own footage plus a grey reference card for checking a pipeline.
releaseHighlights:
- Free. No licence key, no watermark, no sign up.
- Draws colour vision illusions procedurally in DaVinci Resolve, one illusion at a time.
- Generated illusions: Simultaneous Contrast, Gamut Expansion, Contrast vs Expansion Lab Stimulus, Colour Assimilation Stripes, Transparent Filter, Pinwheel Transparency, Contrast as Transparency, Umbrella Stripes, Checker Shadow, Coloured Holes, Gradient Lightness, Shared Texture Discs, Overlapping Squares.
- Passthru illusions that run on your own footage: Histogram Compression, Two Colour Method, Palette Reconstruction.
- Pipeline test image: Grey Reference Card.
- Reveal slider gives the trick away. Keyframe it to wipe the answer in on camera.
- Commentary overlay burns a short explanation panel into the frame, with control over position, size and opacity.
- Runs on the GPU. macOS universal Metal build, Windows and Linux CUDA builds.
